submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires where a formatted document steps back out to a shallower structural level after content: the leading whitespace plus delimiter of a line that dedents relative to the line above it in code, markup or data (a dedented line fires ~2.0 whether it closes a tag or opens one, while the same line at the same indentation without the dedent fires ~0.5; strength grows with depth, nested JSON/HTML at depth 1->4 giving ~0.8->~4.4), and in prose documents the line-initial section index that resumes a numbering scheme after the previous section's body ('2.'/'II.' after a '1.'/'I.' section: 3.8 with the earlier index and a body, 0.9 without it). It is near zero in flat prose, at same-level or indent-increasing lines, and at confident but non-structural continuations.
